race.comment: SHOW BUSINESS (16) savaged the line in her two runs back and will appreciate the faster tempo here. Chased right to the line with a tough second over 1100m at this track. No excuses today and looks great each way value. MAYBE MOET (5) is another from the Matt Smith yard in career best form. Comes back a level after finishing a tidy second over 1000m at Randwick in BM84 class. Since fitted with a 900m trial and looking for J Mac to weave his magic from the draw. FRIENDLY FIRE (15) resumes after showing plenty of potential in three starts at two. Primed with the two solid trials and can figure prominently with the 53kg. HAY STREET (6) comes to hand quickly and the first up run had merit in tougher company. Effective second up and adept in all conditions.
